Console for the whole run: only 3 'Failed to load resource: 401', matching the 3 GET /api/auth/me 401s while signed out. No other errors. Two PUT/DELETE 204 entries read 'FAILED: net::ERR_ABORTED' in the network log; server state confirms they succeeded, so this is a CDP artefact for empty bodies. Harness: with the pane hidden, a view transition can stall until a screenshot forces a frame; a click immediately after an SPA navigation missed twice and worked once a screenshot had been taken. 1280 emulation scales coordinates by 0.625, so ref clicks missed there; coordinate clicks verified by listener.

observations.text: '1 followers' is shown for a count of 1: /u/demo-priya-hollowmere read '1 followers / 0 following' after a follow.

Crates on /profile and /u/<user> are not links: the only anchor in main is Edit profile or Log in to follow, so a collector's crates cannot be opened from their profile. Not an AC, and I did not check whether this predates the branch.
Feed cards on /following show only the tape label (e.g. 'BREAKS / UNDERPASS'), never the crate name ('Overpass Breakbeats'), although the API returns name. Same pattern as Home's link text.

'Crate not found' until reload: not reproduced for a crate created through /crates in the same session; it appears on the tab (/crates/35) and via router push (/crates/36). It does reproduce when the crate is unknown to the already loaded library store: POST /api/crates from outside the store, then SPA navigation to /crates/37 showed 'Crate not found / Browse all crates'. Reachable when a crate is created in another tab or by another user, e.g. from a feed link. CrateView calls library.load() without force.
At 320 and 390 the crate picker stacks about one tab per row with 11+ crates, so the crate itself starts below the first screen on /shelf and /crates/<id>. No horizontal overflow.
Home recommended grid has 7 cards, leaving one orphan on the last row at desktop width; @demo-* handles wrap mid-handle at the hyphen in cards and rows.
Titles stay plain 'Frisson' on /list and the not-found page, while other pages use 'X · Frisson'. Not checked against main.
New-crate form fields take their accessible names from placeholders ('Jazz', 'Same as name') in the accessibility tree. Not checked against main.

Environment: no process listened on 3000 or 5173 during the run; only node pid 91291 on 7343, which is not this app's port. Temp DB copies were deleted afterwards because they held the owner's account row; logs remain in the scratchpad.
